old: Build a real mental model of every system the new code touches. Run the **how** skill over the relevant subsystems. Naming a file isn't grounding. Produce the architectural explanation `how` prescribes.
new: Use current, verified investigation of the systems the change touches. Run the **how** skill only for unresolved gaps; do not repeat a completed investigation or require a separate explanation when the existing findings are sufficient.

old: If it crosses a function boundary, `architect` first. Delegate implementation to a subagent using your configured perf-issue model (default `grok-4.7-xhigh-fast`).
new: Use `architect` for consequential unresolved design choices. Implement directly or delegate separable implementation when useful, honoring the host adapter and configured model-role choices.
